question: The National Pension System Vatsalya (NPS Vatsalya) was launched on
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wed Sep 18 2024 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Pension System Vatsalya (NPS Vatsalya) is a government-initiated pension scheme.
 
• It was launched on **Wed Sep 18 2024**.
 
• The scheme aims to provide a secure and regular income post-retirement to its subscribers.
 
• NPS Vatsalya is targeted at individuals seeking a financially stable retirement plan.
 
• The scheme allows contributions from both the subscriber and the government to build a retirement corpus.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Pension System (NPS)**

 
 
• It is a voluntary, defined contribution retirement savings scheme.
 
• NPS is designed to enable systematic savings during the subscriber's working life.
 
• It is regulated by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA).
 
• The scheme is open to all Indian citizens aged 18-65 years.
 
• Upon retirement, a part of the corpus can be withdrawn, and the remaining amount is used to purchase an annuity for regular income.
 
 
 
• **Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)**
 
 
• It is a statutory body established by the Government of India.
 
• PFRDA is responsible for regulating and developing the pension sector in India.
 
• It ensures the orderly growth and development of the pension market.
 
• The authority also aims to protect the interests of subscribers to pension schemes.
 
 
 
• **Retirement Planning**
 
 
• It involves setting retirement income goals and the actions and decisions necessary to achieve those goals.
 
• It includes identifying sources of income, estimating expenses, implementing a savings program, and managing assets and risk.
 
• Effective retirement planning ensures a secure and comfortable post-retirement life.
 
• It is crucial to start planning early to build a sufficient retirement corpus.
 
 
 
• **Annuity**
 
 
• An annuity is a financial product that provides a steady income stream, typically used as part of retirement planning.
 
• It involves making a lump sum payment or series of payments to an insurance company in exchange for regular disbursements.
 
• Annuities can be fixed or variable, immediate or deferred, depending on the terms of the contract.
 
• They help mitigate the risk of outliving one's savings by ensuring a continuous income.
